title: LeadScoreResult
description: Deterministic scoring calculation result with granular dimensional breakdowns, priority, and human review flags.

lead_id.description: Unique identifier of the lead that was scored.

total_score.description: Composite deterministic score (0-100) calculated by rule engine.

priority.description: Actionable priority bracket mapped from total_score thresholds.

score_breakdown.description: Dimensional score breakdown. Points awarded per configurable dimension.

explanations.description: Human-readable justifications for every dimensional score granted or deducted.

requires_human_review.description: True if rules or AI edge conditions require manual human intervention before sales action.

human_review_reasons.description: Specific trigger conditions that flagged this lead for manual inspection.

scored_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of scoring calculation.
